summary: Iteration 83: Tested 3 UI/UX improvements for guardian section - notification bell popup, beneficiary detail page restructuring, and guardian popup redesign. All features working correctly on web.

issues: Ville field shows 'N/A' - missing postal_code/city combination display when data exists
